top_signals.title: Microsoft rolls out fix for Windows 11 crashes, gaming issues
top_signals.summary: Microsoft has started rolling out a permanent fix for a known issue that causes system crashes and gaming issues on Windows 11 devices. [...]

top_signals.title: Webinar: How Google Workspace breaches happen and what to do next
top_signals.summary: Google Workspace breaches can begin with social engineering or forgotten third-party integrations rather than sophisticated exploits. This webinar examines real-world breaches, what happens during the critical first hours, and the security controls that can make the greatest difference. [...]
